lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is Carhenge — the proposed redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific Ave gets two separate hearings on September 30: a special HARC session reviewing preliminary architecture for multiple building clusters, and a Town Council appeal hearing on the lot subdivision that a law firm challenged after P&Z approved it in July. Meanwhile, the Gondola Leadership Committee takes up a consequential choice between federal funding and local project delivery on the 28th, and the County floats a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee at a work session the same day.

notable.stake: Council weighs federal vs. local funding model for gondola rebuild.
